scope: Exploratory method design, not a public preregistration, paper novelty claim or execution of every branch.
research_question: Verified revisions, preservation of valid dependencies, and bounded re-derivation in long reasoning.
sequence: P1 CPU annotation of frozen historical sample
Choose P05-format OR P05-topology if worth testing

readouts.common: 按题目原始定义核算，不预设复核记录正确。
readouts.direct:
按题目原始定义核算，不预设复核记录正确。
只写“最终答案：整数”。
readouts.one_line:
按题目原始定义核算，不预设复核记录正确。
先写一行必要计算，再写“最终答案：整数”。
readouts.role: same user follow-up boundary in all cells; rebuild Full within every readout condition; no gold or new computed y/z

P1.selection: ID + fixed salt SHA; no correctness/Wait/length filtering
P1.use: historical development observation; FULL-policy with forced boxed readout, not uninterrupted-native
P1.decision: 5% is an investment threshold, not automatic proof from a point estimate; no hard kill from unreviewed/capped negatives

P05_format.purpose: readout policy effect and mask interaction; not proof of computational impossibility or causal mediation

P05_topology.tokenizer_mapping_status: pending CPU mapping and no-model freeze before GPU launch
P05_topology.clause_padding: ID-level global width; no retokenization after padding
P05_topology.same_masked_token_budget: closure and sham must each mask exactly 3*slot_width
controls: prefill and readout forbidden/causal attention zero
P05_topology.partial_policy: fixed E/C/W blocks; stop before deadline, report only complete pairs, no replacement by easier/shorter cases

gradient.math_object: VCORE-style SGD first-order utility, not causal importance or faithful author-stack reproduction
gradient.parameter_scope_candidate: LoRA rank 8 q_proj/v_proj, all layers, dropout 0; must freeze exact trainable names/init/dtype before calls
splits: H heldout, not used for q/tau/eta
reference_objectives: conclusion/answer span NLL on same reference context
gradient.cost_accounting: shared reference forward, two directional gradient queries, baseline main forward, two perturbed main forwards; update/backward/validation separate
gradient.q: Gibbs with matched KL to uniform, delta=0.05; q detached; report raw and normalized direction scores
gradient.semantic_bins: phase preECN/ECN/postECN x role ordinary/wrong/correction/necessary verification/confirmed redundant/unknown

G1.precision: FP32 short directional admission preferred; if lower precision used, explicit nonzero perturbation and epsilon stability required

G2.control: same L2 update norm; original-scale behavior separate
G2.primary: actual heldout pre-conclusion answer NLL delta versus first-order predicted delta

gradient.stop: nonfinite, restoration error, quantized-zero/unstable probe, no stable signal, heldout fails, or actual cost exceeds budget; do not scale to32 automatically

non_combination_rule: Do not multiply the P05 readout and topology grids or launch all branches together.
limitations: This protocol is locally versioned design; no future model performance exists.
AST dependencies and known correct revisions are controlled experimental information.
Historical traces cannot be relabeled as a new independent blind test.
Single-step NLL is not generation accuracy, token saving or full training generalization.
